summary: performance lens over statement-export-api (9 product path(s), fb7d13c..1327f6e, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 0 non-blocking. The export path otherwise follows the performance-sensitive contracts shown in the bundle: it invokes the statement service once, branches before headers, and writes the supplied payload without additional queries or subtotal derivation. However, the newly optional writer dependency is a blocking compatibility-only allowance and creates an explicitly permitted fail-late controller state.
